36743.subject: Chemistry
36743.question_text: An element Z has a combining power of 3. Which of the following formulae is correct of its compounds?
36743.explanation: When two elements combine with each other to form compounds, they do so by exchanging their valencies or combining powers. From the question, Z has a combining power of 3, therefore any element it will combine with among the options must have its valency swapped with that of Z. Among the options, only option C is correct because Oxygen has a valency of 2 while Z has valency of 3. As they combine, Z takes the valency of Oxygen which is 2 while Oxygen takes the valency of Z which is 3.

36759.subject: Chemistry
36759.question_text: 9.60 g of a gas X occupies the same volume at 0.30 g of hydrogen under the same conditions. Calculate the molar mass of X [H = 1]
36759.explanation:
Using the ideal gas equation, 

PV = nRT.

where \(n = \frac{mass}{\text{molar mass}}\).

For Hydrogen, \(\frac{m_H}{M_H} = \frac{PV}{RT}\).

For element X, \(\frac{m_X}{M_X} = \frac{PV}{RT}\)

Under the same conditions implies \(\frac{PV}{RT}\) is the same for both hydrogen and X.

\(\frac{m_H}{M_H} = \frac{m_X}{M_X}\)

Molar mass of X = \(\frac{\text{molar mass of hydrogen} \times \text{mass of X}}{\text{mass of hydrogen}}\)

= \(\frac{2 \times 9.6}{0.3}\)

= 64 g/mol

36776.subject: Chemistry
36776.question_text: A finely divided form of a metal burns more readily in air than the rod form because the rod has
36776.explanation:
The metallic rod has a small surface area relative to the same mass of finely grounded metal. This means that more particles of the finely grounded metal will be in contact with air than the metallic rod. As a result, there can be more successful collisions per unit time and the reaction of finely grounded metal is faster.

Increasing the surface area of the reactants increases the rate of the reaction. Thus, option B is the correct answer.

36777.subject: Chemistry
36777.question_text: Which of the following will displace copper from a solution of copper (ll) salt?
36777.explanation:
The tendency of a metal displacing the other is based on their position in the electrochemicals series. The metal above the other will displace the lower. Magnesium, Aluminium and Zinc are all above Copper, hence, by default, they should all displace Copper, but the option says Alumimium ion and Zinc ion, not Aluminium metal and Zinc metal. It is only Magnesium that is in metallic form not ion.Therefore, the answer is Magnesium. Option B 

You can make reference to your electrochemical series.

36778.subject: Chemistry
36778.question_text: What is the value of x in the following equation? Cr2O72- + 14H+ + xe- → 2Cr3+ + 7H2O
36778.explanation:
Cr2O72- + 14H+ + xe- → 2Cr3+ + 7H2O

Consider the total ionic substances on the LHS and that on the RHS

LHS= -2 (from Cr2O7 2-) + 14 (from 14H+) +x  = -2 +14 + x

RHS= 2 x +3 (from 2Cr3+) = +6

Equate LHS and RHS

-2 + 14 + x = +6  (ensure both values on the LHS and RHS are equal)

   +12 + x = +6

     x = 6 -12 = -6 (minus because its an electron)

 thus, x = 6.      Option B is the correct answer (See also image attached)

36828.question_text: P,Q,R and S are metals in the same group in the Periodic Table but in periods 3,4, 5 and 6 respectively which of them loses electrons least readily?
